notes: All paths are relative to the package root and preserve the original exported folder names.
Source exports are read-only evidence. They are not copied into the production app as runtime CSS/HTML.
preferredSourceHtml is populated only when an exact Page-ID HTML source is unambiguous; otherwise inspect the full candidate list and handoff.
artboardSelector is null unless an explicit selector is confirmed; do not guess selectors.
Only files in explicit previews/screenshots folders are recorded as screenshots. Pixel dimensions are recorded; CSS viewport/device scale is not inferred.
